FileIngestion._ImportsPathHelp: Omit or leave ImportsPath empty to use <executable-dir>/imports. Examples: Linux absolute '/imports', Windows absolute 'C:\\imports', relative to content root 'imports' or 'data/incoming'.

InsightsWorker._ProviderHelp: None = no genera insights. Ollama = local, ningun dato sale del sistema (default). OpenAI = envia Date/Description/Amount/Currency de cada transaccion a la API de OpenAI -- requiere elegirlo aca explicitamente, nunca se activa solo por tener OpenAI:ApiKey configurada. Both = corre Ollama y OpenAI. Ver docs/Architecture/ProveedorDeInsights.md.
